description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices, each representing a distinct data source with a label, color, and percentage value. The largest slice is NQ at 31.3%, followed by FEVER at 16.1%, SNLI at 15.4%, and MULTINLI at 11.3%. Other notable contributors include VITAMINC at 13.0%, ANLI at 4.6%, and FACTCC at 2.6%. The remaining smaller slices are SCITAIL at 1.2%, PUBHEALTH at 0.5%, ENTFA at 1.8%, and XSUMHUL at 1.6%, with SCIFACT being the smallest at 0.1%. Each slice is distinctly colored and labeled with a connecting line, and the percentages are explicitly shown next to their respective labels. The chart does not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded. The slices are arranged in descending order of size around the center.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, comprising 13 slices. Each slice represents a specific data source with distinct labels, colors, and percentage values. The largest data source is NQ, accounting for approximately 31.3% of the dataset, followed by FEVER at 16.1%. SNLI and MULTINLI are the next largest contributors, with 15.4% and 11.3%, respectively. Notably, VITAMINC shows a steady decline in its contribution compared to previous years, now accounting for only 8.0% of the dataset. Additionally, SCIFACT and PUBHEALTH are among the smallest contributors, with SCIFACT slightly exceeding PUBHEALTH at 0.7% and 0.5%, respectively. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each data source in the training set.
